description: EE1: Transform copies the real types of a roosting target and its added type. Setup turn 1: Snorlax's Night Shade takes 50 HP from Corviknight, Pelipper's Trick-or-Treat adds Ghost to it. Setup turn 2: Pelipper switches out for Ditto (Limber). The turn: Corviknight Roosts (Flying left out: it shows as Steel); Ditto's Transform takes `roost.typeWas` (Flying/Steel) and the added Ghost; so Hippowdon's High Horsepower (Ground) and Snorlax's Body Slam at its ally Ditto (Normal) both miss out on it (immune).
